decisions_locked.rationale: Checking publisherHistory for last successful publish before creating Playwright BrowserContext completely eliminates unnecessary Chromium spawns during the 60-minute forum cooldown window.
Replacing the 5-minute spin loop with now + remainingMinutes + 1m for rate limits and 15m -> 30m -> 60m for unexpected errors protects the forum account from spam bans and stops CPU/memory churn.
Hooking page.once('dialog') before clicking write button prevents unhandled alert auto-dismissal from causing misleading downstream draft modal selector errors.
Adding --test-concurrency=1 in scripts/run-tests.sh ensures integration tests sharing the temporary hermetic state files do not suffer file-write race conditions.
